text:
maria: Need temporary burst allow for ACME Corp demo tomorrow 09:00 PT. Org org_987, single API key. Can we get ~10x for 2h? @kai @dan

dan: This is a live eval with legal and procurement watching — if we can't demo the throughput the deal goes cold. Need fast path.

kai: What's the exact QPS target and is this per-key or org-level? Also which model + region? We need to decide routing (dedicated pool vs hosted).

maria: Per-key -> api_key_abc123. Expected ~250qps sustained, current quota 25qps. Window 08:00-10:00 UTC. Need auto-expire and audit trail.

sanjay: We can grant a temporary lease but prefer routing to a demo-dedicated pool to avoid noisy neighbor effects. Any model preference? That affects cost and warmup.

dan: Use `small-lt` (low-cost, slightly higher latency). Latency tolerance ok for this demo.

kai: Ok. We'll do a temporary allowlist entry pinned to `dedicated-pool-demo-1` with fallback to `small-lt`. Security approval required. Also will attach `temp.allow_id` to telemetry.

leah: Security ok for one-off but require reason, approver, and no bypass of billing checks. Must auto-expire and show in audit.

kai: Command I'll run (internal):

```bash
rictl allow add --org org_987 --key api_key_abc123 --qps 250 --duration 2h --expires \"2026-03-19T10:00:00Z\" --reason \"sales demo\" --approver kai
```

ops-bot: Created request REQ-20260319-42 pending approvals :robot_face:

maria: I filed an approval ticket #REQ-20260319-42 in Zendesk and added Dan as approver.

dan: Approving now — :+1: greenlight from sales. @kai please proceed.

kai: Will schedule the window and update routing policy. Also adding `temp.allow_id=REQ-20260319-42` tag to telemetry and console so Support can trace.

sanjay: Set `max_burst=500` and `smoothing=1s` on the policy so we avoid token storms; also add short prefix cache TTL.

kai: Done, applying now.

ops-bot: Allowlist entry created: ALLOW-1357. Expires in 2 hours. Audit log: https://redwood.internal/logs/ALLOW-1357

maria: Confirmed — demo ran, customer happy. Thanks everyone.

leah: Quick note: add to playbook that sales cannot request repeated extensions without CS and Legal sign-off.

kai: Will add checklist and a console UX change: one-click temp allow with required approver, auto-expire, and cost preview.

dan: Perf numbers: p95 ~180ms, cost delta looks like a spike. Please send cost impact to finance.

sanjay: Tagged dataset: `cost.delta:$120` for the 2h window.

maria: Closing thread — demo successful, entry expired as scheduled. TY all.
